speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: But it cannot just be the security agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singaporeans need to help safeguard family and friends from becoming radicalised.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Employers need to pay attention on what is going on in workers' dormitories, for example.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Workers, too, can play a part in reporting suspicious activities that they may come across.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In short, everyone has a part to play to enhance our collective security.

speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
text: But what would be our threshold for stimulus or to take action, for example?

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: The sizing, how they are structured and so on, have to be cleared by the security agencies.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: For example, quite apart from issues of terrorism, there are other issues related to possible violence and we need to be able to move in and deal with that.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: With regard to the second question about the gathering of foreign workers in specific places, I will start with this caveat.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: Having said that, I think we recognise the point the Member has made and there are some imperatives.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: First, we need them here, for example, for construction and some of the other types of work.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: But then, that imposes cost on businesses and the economy.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: At the same time, we have to manage the gatherings.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: For example, by using the Police and other uniformed services; sometimes, you do not need a Police officer dealing with these issues.

speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
text: I do not want to give the impression that, therefore, everything is perfect, but it is certainly a problem that has been recognised.
